evidence: src/external_signer.cpp and test/functional/wallet_signer.py govern how the wallet interacts with external hardware signers to sign transactions.
rationale: The PR adds defensive validation to protect user funds if an external signer is buggy or compromised. It checks that 'the signer did not change output count, amounts, or scriptPubKeys, and that all attached signatures and input sighash types commit to all outputs', mitigating risks of modified outputs or unsafe sighashes.
